source.text:
12 April 2026
Harrowdene Housing Association
Our reference: UQ-9284511

Dear Malcolm,

Thank you for reporting the fault with your boiler. We have booked Edwards Maintenance to visit on 10 May 2026 between 8am and 6pm.

Someone over 18 must be at home to let the engineer in. If nobody is home the visit will be recorded as a no-access and rebooked, which may take several weeks.

If the time does not suit you, call us on 0300 123 6060 at least two working days before the visit to rearrange.

The engineer will carry identification. You are welcome to ask to see it.

Kind regards,
Mr Phillip Ferguson
Harrowdene Housing Association
